decisions: Skeleton is a decorative div whose source accepts caller className; text/avatar/card here are explicit caller classes, not invented shape props. Native16px text height,40px avatar,125px card height and8px/round corners are retained. Text/card width fills caller space rather than fixing the290px specimen width. The host supplies aria-busy and readable loading status; decorative shape is hidden from accessibility. Static Figma has no timing; a chosen2s pulse to50% opacity expresses source animate-pulse, and reduced-motion removes the animation without removing status.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
